scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide landscape inline picture-book painting for a Japanese graded-reading story
Primary request: illustrate the end of paragraph 0 of “The Egg Errand”: Mio is ready to go to the shop on her first errand, carrying the money and small note Mum gave her.
Scene/backdrop: A quiet Japanese family home in the morning. Show a simple doorway and a low table, with Mum staying home beside the baby's sleeping futon.
Subject: Mio is an elementary-school-age Japanese girl with dark hair in a low ponytail, a terracotta-red cardigan, navy skirt, small red backpack and a simple cream canvas shopping bag. Her mother is an adult Japanese woman with dark hair in a low bun, a muted sage top and pale cream apron. Mum sits beside the sleeping baby and places a few plain coins and a small blank paper slip on the low table for Mio to collect. Mio is just gathering them before stepping out. Make the paper completely blank; do not draw any writing.
Style/medium: children's picture-book gouache in the approved simple inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and soft shadows, quiet simplified background. Use warm ivory, sage, muted teal, indigo, soft ochre and restrained terracotta. Keep the detail flatter and simpler than cover art.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape about 12:7, a wide side view of the home interior; show mother and sleeping baby in one calm area, Mio and the open doorway in another, with the small table between them. Two or three quiet depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft morning daylight, loving and reassuring, with a little first-errand anticipation.
Constraints: one child, one mother, one sleeping baby; the money and blank note are visible. No text, lettering, title, labels, border or watermark. Original composition.
Avoid: copying a portrait-cover layout, extra people, extra children, visible writing on the note, readable signs, brand marks, photorealism, dense texture, clutter, dramatic lighting, logos.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: second wide landscape inline picture-book painting for a Japanese graded-reading story
Primary request: illustrate the end of paragraph 1 of “The Egg Errand”: after running away from a large barking dog, Mio reaches the shop and discovers the note is missing from her pocket.
Scene/backdrop: A modest neighbourhood shop entrance beside a quiet road, shown with simple shelves just inside and a low hedge along the path. Keep all signs blank and the background uncluttered.
Subject: The same elementary-school-age Japanese girl, Mio, with dark hair in a low ponytail, terracotta-red cardigan, navy skirt, small red backpack and cream canvas shopping bag. She stands by the shop doorway, looking worried as she checks her empty pocket. A large but ordinary family dog is a short distance away behind the low hedge; it has barked but is not snarling or lunging. Mio is startled and has just run, but is now safe at the shop. Do not show the missing note.
Style/medium: children's picture-book gouache in the approved simple inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and soft shadows, quiet simplified background. Use warm ivory, sage, muted teal, indigo, soft ochre and restrained terracotta. Keep detail flatter and simpler than cover art.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape about 12:7, medium-wide view. Focus on Mio checking her pocket near the shop entrance; show the large dog clearly but small and safely separated in the background. Two or three calm depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight, a moment of worry settling into puzzlement; gentle rather than frightening.
Constraints: exactly one girl and one dog; the note is absent. No words, lettering, readable signs, title, labels, border or watermark. Original composition.
Avoid: extra people, aggressive teeth, attack, chase action, injury, speech bubbles, text, logos, photorealism, dense texture, busy shelves, dramatic shadows.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: third wide landscape inline picture-book painting for a Japanese graded-reading story
Primary request: illustrate the end of paragraph 2 of “The Egg Errand”: at the shop counter, Mio remembers that she should buy eggs and asks the shopkeeper for them.
Scene/backdrop: A small neighbourhood grocery with a simple wooden counter and a few quiet shelves of jars and vegetables. Keep shelves orderly and any packaging blank.
Subject: The same elementary-school-age Japanese girl, Mio, with dark hair in a low ponytail, terracotta-red cardigan, navy skirt, small red backpack and cream canvas shopping bag. A kind middle-aged Japanese woman shopkeeper stands behind the counter with a small plain basket of eggs. Mio has just remembered what to ask for; she looks relieved and points gently toward the eggs. The shopkeeper smiles and reaches toward the basket. Show no note, since Mio lost it.
Style/medium: children's picture-book gouache in the approved simple inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and soft shadows, quiet simplified background. Use warm ivory, sage, muted teal, indigo, soft ochre and restrained terracotta. Keep detail flatter and simpler than cover art.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape about 12:7, medium-wide two-shot at counter height; keep Mio's relieved expression and the basket of eggs easy to read, with two or three calm depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft shop light, a small moment of confidence and relief.
Constraints: one girl, one middle-aged shopkeeper, a simple basket of eggs, no note. No words, lettering, price labels, signs, title, border or watermark. Original composition.
Avoid: extra people, readable packaging, text or symbols, a dog, photorealism, dense texture, clutter, dramatic lighting, logos.
